The '''1974–75 Cypriot First Division''' was the 36th season of the Cypriot top-level [[Association football|football]] league.

==Overview==
It was contested by 14 teams, and [[AC Omonia]] won the championship. [[APOEL F.C.|APOEL]] did not participate in the [[1974–75 Alpha Ethniki|Greek championship]], even though they were not relegated in the previous season, due to the volatile situation in [[Cyprus]] in 1974. They competed in the championship unofficially, but their matches did not count towards the official league table.
